prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A close-up shot of a sleek, modern "ebook pro" tablet box resting on a sheet of bubble wrap atop a clean, white tabletop. The box is angled slightly, showcasing its minimalist design with geometric patterns and a product image of the tablet on the cover. The color palette is cool and subdued, dominated by whites, soft grays, and muted greens, with the box standing out crisply against the neutral background. In the softly blurred background, several bright orange and yellow DHL shipping boxes and a partially visible camera add context, suggesting a tech unboxing or shipping environment. The lighting is bright and even, with a slight cool tint, creating a clinical, high-tech atmosphere. The composition uses a shallow depth of field, keeping the focus sharply on the ebook box while the background elements remain out of focus, enhancing the sense of anticipation and highlighting the product as the central subject. The overall style is clean, modern, and product-focused, reminiscent of commercial product photography or a cinematic unboxing sequence.
